entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Sarah Jenkins. The order is VF98765.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the Urban Commuter Helmet. I see it was delivered just a few days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The color is not what I expected. I just want to return it. The box is unopened.

I understand. Getting the right color is important. Since it's a preference issue and not a fault with the helmet, I can definitely process a return for you. Our standard return policy for gear like this is 10 days, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe.
Fine. So what do I do?

I'm generating a return authorization for you now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label. You just need to print it, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the helmet, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. We want to ensure you're completely satisfied with your gear's fit, color, and safety features.
Of course. I've just sent it to the email address on file. You should receive it within the next 5 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sarah?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
